reviews.text: We went to visit the place to ask for information; we wanted to leave our dog there. Everything looked great from the outside, but when we asked to see the facilities, they told us they weren't open to the public at any time. We found that strange and decided against leaving him there for a planned vacation and training session. We can't comment on the rest of the experience.

We discovered Juewoof a couple of months ago, and since then it's been Rocky's favorite place to socialize with other dogs.
From the very first contact, the customer service has been excellent. When we arrive with Rocky, Ale and the other team members always greet us with a smile and make sure he's in good health.
During his stay, they keep me updated with photos and videos and let me know how much he's eaten. At checkout, the process is very quick, and I've never had any problems or injuries with Rocky. The best part is that he leaves his day pass exhausted! 🐕‍🦺
I highly recommend Juewoof! 🐾 The prices seem reasonable to me, and they have coupon books.

I love it!!!!
We enrolled my golden retriever in the day pass program for obedience training. He learned so much! Before, walks were a problem, and he struggled with people because he was very reactive. Little by little, we saw improvement, and now we have a calm dog. It was a fantastic experience, honestly. He loved going to play with his furry friends. Highly, highly, highly recommended.

For Nina and us, Juewoof has been a space of freedom, play, and care.

We have the best photos thanks to them!

Excellent place! I highly recommend them; they treated my little girl Nala (chow chow) wonderfully. I'm delighted; I always leave her in good hands! Greetings and thanks for everything. Highly recommended.
An excellent place for your canine friend, they enjoy their stay, socialize, and are thoroughly checked ♥️

My experience at Juewoof has been truly wonderful. Bonnie arrives and leaves happy and tired every time.

They offer at least two activities a day to keep them mentally stimulated, and they also helped us follow the vet's instructions to the letter when she injured her paw.

The Juewoof team is incredibly friendly and provides updates throughout the day.

I highly recommend them for both day passes and boarding.
It's the BEST hotel and daycare I've ever been to!! The service is excellent; they keep me updated on all my dog's activities and meals. Roko is so happy!! I truly recommend it 100%.

I love it! My dogs love it. They're always so happy to go. I like that they keep them busy with activities, and above all, they take such good care of them. They're in constant contact and send you photos so you know how your babies are doing during their stay. Highly recommended. 🐶❤️

Juewoof has become like family to Ares! 💕 It's been our solution so Ares isn't alone at home on the days we're working. He loves going, and it helps him learn so many things, like socializing with other dogs, commands, and burning off all his energy. We're so relieved because they send us lots of photos and videos of the activities they do! 🥹 Thank you for being such a great support to us and Ares!

I'm so happy when I take my Tobby to JUEWOOF Perisur. I always feel at ease because he's treated with respect, and they always share their daily routine with me. My dog's attitude when we arrive there is always so happy; he knows he'll get to play.
The best place for your dog to have fun. Group and individual activities are my favorites.

Juewoof is a place I highly recommend. I've left my dog ​​there both for day passes and at the hotel, and I love that they always keep an eye on your pet, keep them super active, and have affordable prices.
My dog ​​loves going, and I like that he socializes instead of being completely alone ✨

Rocket is so happy at his DayPass!

The truth is, Rocket is a very active and demanding puppy/teenager in many ways, and all his caregivers are incredibly patient and loving with him 💖

Rocket loves going, and they always send me photos, videos, activities, and memes of my boy!

Their facilities are very clean, the caregivers are very friendly, and I highly recommend them.
Excellent place to leave your pet...I'm amazed at what they're achieving.
I've been looking for this my whole life because I was worried about my job and my pet, but here they take care of him like he's at home 💕 …

I have left both my dogs under their care two times for over 10 days and my dogs love going there. I get video updates multiple times a day, information on how well they are eating, and activities they are completing. The customer service with them has been great as well, they are always very professional and friendly. I trust them with my dogs and will continue to bring them for any overnight stays. Thank you for your service!!!!

We highly recommend Juewoof because they are an excellent place for continuity and communication with pet owners. We left our dog at a hotel for several days, and during his stay, we noticed in the daily reports, and Juewoof also noticed, that our little guy started losing some weight. Later, we detected a skin issue (dermatitis). At first, it's worrying because these are things you don't always expect to happen beforehand, or that they might appear, I imagine due to a change in environment, activity, or other factors. What did give us a lot of peace of mind was the communication with us. They were constantly sending us information, and the reports on his feeding and how he was eating were important. They even gave us suggestions to help with his weight loss and offered to take him to the vet to have his skin checked. They kept us informed of all the progress and were always attentive to every detail.

In the end, our dog returned home healthy, calm (more than we expected), and in good spirits. I think that beyond the fact that these kinds of things can happen, what's important is how the place responds, and in our case, we felt they were clear, attentive, and responsible at all times. It's definitely worth it!

A very good experience. We've tried other places, and this was where we had the best communication, from the hotel to when we left him at the kennel. That's much appreciated, because you know how your dog is doing at all times.
My dog ​​loves going there; they constantly send photos and updates of your dog. And the staff is very friendly.

In our experience…😊
Leaving your dog in a place like this is always a bit nerve-wracking at first, and you want to feel at ease.

In our case, before we left them, they explained how they work and what might happen due to the change in routine or living with other dogs, etc. But during their stay, they were very attentive: they sent us photos and videos, and also told us how they were eating, drinking water, and how they seemed. Among other reports, and so on. That's what gave us confidence, because we didn't feel like they were just showing us "the pretty parts," but that there was real follow-up.

(Our little ones stayed at Juewoof for a month)

Overall, it went well, and our dogs returned calm. I think that in these services, the most important thing is communication and clarity, and in our experience, they definitely deliver on that. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dobby and Valentina give them!

Excellent place with plenty of space and the best care for my dog.
They always send timely reports and are attentive to every message, responding as soon as possible. Highly recommended.

We've been taking our dog to a daycare service for a while now, and it's always been a great experience.
Over the years, something we've come to really appreciate is the attention and supervision they provide throughout the day, as well as the training they've given our family and our dog. It gives us great peace of mind to leave him in these places because we already know how they work. And for our dog, it's like a second home and family.
Thanks, Juewoof!
Excellent service, the dogs are very well cared for and happy ❤️😍🫶🏼 …

We really liked the daycare. Max has stayed there several times. The last time he didn't want to eat, and they kept us updated the whole time. They even encouraged him to eat with treats and activities until he finally did. They send videos and photos every day, and the daily activities they provide help keep them active. He looks happy in the photos, which gives us a lot of peace of mind. Their drop-off service is very convenient. I definitely recommend it.

One of the best experiences we've had with our dog in a place like this. We've left Paco at Juewoof before, and we can say we're delighted with the day pass. The staff really dedicates time to the dogs, teaching them things like kindergarten, and now our little dog is much more stable at home. For those who truly want help managing their velociraptor, Juewoof is the perfect choice! They're also very transparent about their services, explaining everything in detail. The staff are very kind and knowledgeable! We're so happy here!

If I could give this place zero stars, I would.

The worst experience for me and my dog.
I spent ages looking for places to leave my dog ​​because, like you, I was afraid he'd be hurt or abused. I left my dog ​​for six days while I was on a business trip, and I chose Juewoof because their facilities looked very clean and their website raved about them. But honestly, if you can find another place, do it!

They returned my dog ​​to me malnourished and extremely dehydrated, very weak, unable to stand. That same night, they had to give him an IV drip. He lost a lot of weight and had diarrhea and vomiting. I understand that some dogs are very dependent and emotional and have a hard time, but that's why I left him with "expert" people. They just send you photos and videos, which I don't want to think the worst, but they seem staged as a facade. In reality, you never know what the living situation and treatment are like. On the fourth day, the photos they sent me showed the dog looking very sad, and I told them he seemed unwell. All they said was, "He loves running with his friends." The dog was severely dehydrated; they never told me he was feeling sick or losing strength. When I picked him up, I noticed he was weak. He didn't greet me like usual, even though he's a young dog. He couldn't get into the truck and slipped because he was too weak. His back legs had been hurting for a while, I imagine from the dehydration. They told me he probably hurt himself getting into the truck to avoid taking responsibility. Five days have passed, and my dog ​​is still weak. It's truly worrying because if I hadn't arrived that day, I don't know what would have happened. I imagine they don't check properly whether the dogs are drinking enough water, or what kind of water they're giving them. One more day, and I don't know what would have happened. I wish they had informed me sooner so someone could have picked him up and taken him to the shelter. I don't recommend this place. They charge a lot of money, and to give him back his pet in this condition, I can't afford the vet bills or anything else. It's not fair. Look for another place where the service is more personalized.
